name: Deckaura Tarot MCP Server
description: Query all 78 tarot card meanings, draw cards, create three-card spreads, and answer yes-or-no questions through MCP using Deckaura's structured dataset.
author: Deckaura

tools.name: get_card_meaning
tools.description: Get upright, reversed, love, and career meanings for a specific tarot card.

card_name.description: Name of the tarot card, such as The Fool or Ace of Cups.

tools.name: draw_random_card
tools.description: Draw one random card from the complete 78-card deck, optionally allowing reversals.

reversed_allowed.description: Whether the card may appear reversed; defaults to true.

tools.name: three_card_spread
tools.description: Draw a past-present-future spread and return an interpretation for each position.

question.description: Optional question to focus the reading on.

tools.name: list_all_cards
tools.description: List all 78 tarot cards with their names, arcana, and suits.

tools.name: yes_no_reading
tools.description: Draw one card for a yes-or-no question and return its verdict.

resources.name: Full 78-card deck
resources.description: Complete Major and Minor Arcana meanings dataset

resources.name: Deckaura
resources.description: Official Deckaura website, tarot card guides, and tools
